crisisMatrix.driver: Ready Forward bank receipts misused to funnel PSU bank treasury funds to corner speculative equities (ACC skyrocketed).
crisisMatrix.reforms: SEBI statutory charter (SEBI Act 1992), Dematerialization Act (NSDL/CDSL), birth of the National Stock Exchange (NSE).

crisisMatrix.driver: US sanctions post nuclear tests, sovereign credit downgrade to junk, Thai Baht contagion triggering emerging market liquidations.
crisisMatrix.reforms: Resurgent India Bonds ($4.2B Forex mobilized), Golden Quadrilateral infrastructure push by Vajpayee administration.

crisisMatrix.driver: Circular leverage in K-10 tech stocks (HFCL, DSQ, Global Tele) using co-op bank pay orders; NASDAQ collapse & 9/11 shock.
crisisMatrix.reforms: Centuries-old Badla settlement abolished (July 2001), NSE equity derivatives (F&O) born, Rolling Settlement (T+2) mandated.

crisisMatrix.driver: US subprime freeze, Lehman bankruptcy, dollar funding drought, FII net liquidation of ₹53,000 Cr ($12B).
crisisMatrix.reforms: Aggressive counter-cyclical monetary policy (Repo cut to 4.75%), domestic liquidity injection, P-Notes transparency.

crisisMatrix.driver: Fed QE tapering telegraph, twin deficits with CAD hitting record 4.8% of GDP, USD/INR crashed to 68.85.
crisisMatrix.reforms: RBI FCNR(B) swap window raising $34B forex cushion, Urjit Patel Inflation-Targeting Framework (4% ± 2%).

crisisMatrix.driver: 86% cash ban (2016); AAA-rated IL&FS default (2018) triggering shadow-banking freeze, mutual fund credit runs.
crisisMatrix.reforms: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC 2016) enforcement, Corporate Tax slashed to 22% (Sept 2019), banking AQR clean-up.

crisisMatrix.driver: Global quarantine, complete supply-chain halt, record single-month FII dump of ₹61,973 Cr in March 2020.
crisisMatrix.reforms: Retail SIP explosion (monthly SIPs surged from ₹8,000 Cr to >₹24,000 Cr), Demat accounts crossed 160M, PLI schemes.

sweetSpot.corporateImpact: EBITDA bonanza for Paints (Asian Paints), Adhesives (Pidilite), Tyres (MRF), Airlines (IndiGo).
sweetSpot.valuationMultiple: Nifty P/E expands +1.5x to +2.5x on margin certainty.

frictionPoint.corporateImpact: Upstream (ONGC, Oil India) benefits; downstream OMCs face retail fuel marketing margin freezes.

stressZone.corporateImpact: 150-300 bps operating margin compression across automotive, FMCG, and capital goods.
stressZone.valuationMultiple: Nifty derates 10%–18% as institutional risk premium surges.

macroMetrics.fiiVsDiiRatio: DII AUM surpassed FII for first time in history (52% vs 48%)
